target_subject: two overlapping human silhouettes in embrace

Fabric patches contain printed patterns including floral motifs, abstract swirls, and faint illegible text
action: The left figure’s arm wraps around the right figure’s back, with hand visible near the right figure’s shoulder
The right figure’s hand rests on the left figure’s chest or abdomen area

rationale: The overlapping outlines suggest physical proximity rather than separate standing positions

The use of patchwork fabric indicates intentional artistic construction rather than photographic realism

The right silhouette has a smaller head, narrower shoulders, and one hand placed flat on the left silhouette’s midsection.

limitations: No facial features or contextual setting prevents confirmation of interpersonal intent.
